title: OS Quality Scorecard
description: The filled sixteen dimension rubric for one version of one OS. Read by TOOLS/score_os.py, which applies the release threshold. Scores are judged, the threshold arithmetic is not.

version.description: The version scored. Scores are versioned, never overwritten: the trend is the point.

scored_by.description: Who or what produced these scores. A scorecard with no author is an assertion.

tier.description: Which verify.py tier the package passed before it was scored. Scoring a package that fails CORE is scoring a draft.

evidence.description: The specific observation behind the number, citing a file. A score with no evidence is a vibe with a decimal point.

waivers.description: A waiver lifts the per dimension minimum for ONE non critical dimension. It can never lift the average threshold, and never applies to evidence_discipline, operating_logic, artifact_quality, security or testability.

gate.description: The eighteen item release gate result, recorded alongside the scores. See EVALS/RELEASE-GATE.md.
